newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania's equity market rises this week.
newsitem.headline: Romania's equity market rises this week.

text.p: Romania's equity market rose by 0.4 percent on Friday from the previous session, an independent index showed.

The unofficial VAB-General index, a capitalisation-weighted index of the Bucharest bourse and the over-the-counter (OTC) market, was 7.0 percent higher on the week at 747.9, according to VANGUARD securities, which computes it.
Trading on RASDAQ -- the Romanian OTC system modelled on the U.S. NASDAQ -- was lively but shares were volatiles as most investors were awaiting company results for 1996..
"Shares prices floated due to unofficial news on results," one trader said. "That mood will stay in the market next week."
Most Romanian companies are expected to start releasing data on their financial results last year starting April 15.
The independent VAB-RASDAQ index rose 7.2 percent on the week to 2,185.3 points.
Cement maker Casial remained Friday's top performer, with 453,557 shares traded. It closed 50 lei firmer at 950.
Volumes on the RASDAQ fell to 2.62 million shares from 3.19 million on Thursday, with turnover slightly on the rise at 5.4 billion lei from 5.2 billion.
The system, which lists 2,719 companies, traded 417 stocks on Friday, with 122 drifting higher, 176 going down and 119 remaining flat.

More than 13.7 million shares changed hands in RASDAQ's five trading days this week, with the total turnover standing at 25 billion lei. Last week the system traded 13.1 million shares worth around 20 billion lei.
Bucharest bourse has no trading on Friday.
